I built Bloks for @bot - it turns a project, hackathon, or client ask into a build-ready handoff! Try it: https://x.ai/bot/w4Rvgudmoi8AEb0FZ3PGg

It guides you through 7 building blocks: Frame → Research → Scope → Brainstorm → Spec → Review → Handoff, with Notion as the home for your docs.

Bloks packs five connectors by default: @NotionHQ, @WisprFlow, @meetgranola, @figma , and @linear - with more optional connectors depending on the mode.
